comparison.title: Hydrocarbon vs perc, honestly
comparison.intro: Perc has been the dry-cleaning standard for fifty years and is still what most shops in Gurugram run. Here is the actual difference, including where perc still wins.
rows: Gentler on delicate fibre; less shrinkage and stress
Harder on sensitive fabrics over repeated cleans
Holds dyes, prints, zari and beadwork
Higher risk of bleeding and fading
Lower VOC emissions; closed-loop recovery and reuse
More aggressive, and better at it
comparison.footnote: Hydrocarbon is a refined petroleum distillate, not a plant-based solvent — we do not market it as green. Where a fabric can safely take water, wet cleaning is the greener choice and we use that instead.

faqs.a: Fifteen services: eco-friendly laundry, premium dry cleaning, steam ironing, wet cleaning, shoe cleaning, bag cleaning, leather cleaning, carpet cleaning, curtain cleaning, sofa and upholstery cleaning, mattress cleaning, toy cleaning, accessories cleaning, blanket and quilt cleaning, and linen cleaning. All include free pickup and delivery.

faqs.q: How do I book a service?
faqs.a: Book online through the website, or call or WhatsApp +91 63 67 600 500. Choose your services, pick a slot, and we handle the rest.
For per-kilo laundry there is a small minimum for free pickup — ask us for your area. For dry cleaning and individual items there is no minimum; every piece counts.

faqs.q: Are your cleaning products safe for babies and sensitive skin?
faqs.a: Yes. We use biodegradable, non-toxic cleansers that are gentle on delicate skin, and the eco-friendly laundry service is built for baby clothes and sensitive skin.

faqs.q: How long does dry cleaning take?
faqs.a: Most dry cleaning is done in 24–48 hours. Express same-day is available in select localities near our Gurgaon hub for an additional charge.

faqs.q: Do you clean wedding lehengas and designer wear?
faqs.a: Yes. Premium dry cleaning is built for high-value garments — wedding lehengas, designer suits, silk sarees and delicate ethnic wear, each handled individually.

faqs.q: Can you clean carpets and curtains at home?
faqs.a: For carpets and curtains we offer both collection to our facility and on-site cleaning for large or fixed installations. Tell us the size and we will advise which suits.

faqs.q: What if an item is damaged during cleaning?
faqs.a: Every item is tagged and tracked. In the rare event of damage we will repair or compensate as set out in our terms.

faqs.q: Do you offer corporate or bulk plans?
faqs.a: Yes — for offices, PGs, hostels, hotels, restaurants and co-living spaces, with volume pricing and scheduled pickups. Email care@wash4you.in.

faqs.q: What payment options do you accept?
faqs.a: UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, cash on delivery and the major mobile wallets.
